caption: The drawing depicts the outline of an apron with a large, rounded, central panel filled in with a grid pattern made up of intersecting horizontal and vertical white lines over a purple-pink background. This central panel is bordered by an outlined but uncolored apron skirt in a wide bell shape. On the left side of the central panel, a small triangular section is colored tan or beige. The apron straps and waist ties are outlined at the top but not filled in with any color. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified sketch of the entire apron, done only in thin pencil outlines, showing the general shape and tie configuration. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream-colored paper with some aged discoloration or small spots around the edges.
title: Apron
